CodeDisplayDefinition
pass PassVisual acuity ≥6/9 in both eyes
refer ReferVisual acuity ≤6/12 in either eye OR ≥2 line difference between eyes
absent AbsentChild was absent on screening day
incomplete IncompleteScreening could not be completed (uncooperative, one eye only)
